bestPractices.description: Avoid autoplay on video and audio elements. [See RWEB_0106](https://rweb.greenit.fr/es/fiches/RWEB_0106-evitar-la-reproduccion-y-carga-automatica-de-videos-y-sonidos)

bestPractices.title: RWEB_0112 - Avoid HTTP redirects (≤ 1)
bestPractices.description: Reduce HTTP redirects to avoid unnecessary round trips. [See RWEB_0112](https://rweb.greenit.fr/en/fiches/RWEB_0112-avoir-redirections)

bestPractices.title: Do not resize images in the browser
bestPractices.description: Do not resize images using the HTML attributes height and width. This sends images in their original size, wasting bandwidth and processor power. A PNG-24 image measuring 350 x 300 px is 41 KB. If you were to resize the same image file in HTML and display it as a 70 x 60 px thumbnail, it would still be 41 KB, when in fact it should be no more than 3 KB! This means 38 KB downloaded for nothing. The best solution is to resize images using software such as Photoshop, without using HTML. bestPractices.description: Fix broken resources (404, 500…) to avoid unnecessary network load and improve user experience.

bestPractices.title: Avoid downloading images that are not displayed
bestPractices.description: Images that are downloaded but hidden waste bandwidth. Use lazy loading or remove them.

bestPractices.title: JavaScript runtime errors detected in console
bestPractices.description: Fix JavaScript errors detected at runtime. These are console.error() calls recorded during page load and indicate broken features. Unlike static linting (RWEB_0043), this check does not cover code style or syntax issues.

bestPractices.title: Browser plugin detected (Flash, Silverlight, Java)
bestPractices.description: Remove Flash, Silverlight and Java applet elements — these plugins are obsolete, insecure and unsupported.

bestPractices.title: Render-blocking external scripts detected
bestPractices.description: Add async or defer to external scripts to prevent blocking the critical rendering path. Render-blocking scripts delay page display and increase CPU usage unnecessarily.
